tests.e2e: no E2E framework in the repository; manual Playwright-driven checks in Chrome (not committed), see manual_checks

manual_checks: Mascot: same resting spot bottom-right through a top->bottom->top scroll of the inbox, pointing round trip, drag held then return on a new bubble, resize (Chrome, 1280x720 and 900x600)
Recorded processes: back arrow on workflow and step pages, keyboard Enter, list search kept
macOS chrome: traffic lights close/minimize/zoom, dock restores ProcureFlow, Helpy app window, learning's desktop-icon finder still finds the icon

Teach (real Claude guardrail compile + ElevenLabs tutor connection): 5102 posted as opex is blocked, alert bubble persists >12 s, re-coding to capex resolves it; tutor websocket receives [SCREEN] ... Now on screen updates

Capture (real Scribe token, /api/frame, /api/policy, /api/tts; synthetic canvas as the shared screen, fake mic): no question while typing 12 s, question spoken ~3 s after the last keystroke while the mouse kept moving, no question repeated, vision events grounded, cost-center change reaches vision, debrief starts after I'm done
Map: real /api/workmap returns a concise task name ('Code and Post Supplier Invoice') and EUR guardrails incl. the quarter-end Kramer rule
Invoice 42 root cause reproduced with the app's own Redact model in Chrome (invoice number tagged BUILDING_NUMBER -> synthetic '42')
Local Convex ledger from the old seed was reseeded automatically; ERP shows the 2026/EUR story
summary: Questions: only typing and speech (Scribe endpoint) hold a live question back; mouse/screen changes never do. A question is committed only when its voice starts, deferred if the expert starts talking/typing first, spoken exactly once.

Screen context: src/shared/screen.ts keeps timestamped screen state (exact ProcureFlow app state + latest vision description, never older over newer). Vision requests are latest-wins. Policy, Helpy replies and the ElevenLabs agents (debrief, tutor) get the current screen; change detection now notices field-value changes.

Invoice 42: Redact misclassified invoice numbers as BUILDING_NUMBER and painted the synthetic '42'. ERP business identifiers are no longer redacted; invoice numbers from models are grounded against the ERP (dropped/scrubbed/never spoken).
Mascot: explicit pointing/dragging/dragged/resting state; rests fixed bottom-right of the viewport, scroll never moves it; drags are temporary and not persisted.
Speech bubbles: no timeouts; each bubble has a topic that a meaningful transition resolves (work, speech, answer, next step, invoice closed, Helpy opened).
Recorded processes: concise generated names (<=5 words, <=48 chars, client and server) and a keyboard-accessible back arrow using the app's page state.
Mock OS: macOS-style window chrome, menu bar and dock (visual only).

Demo story: Stuttgart machine builder, Sabine 24 years, EUR, invoices Aug-Oct 2026 (today 2026-10-04, September close); Kramer double-bills at every quarter-end (user decision), guardrail month in [3,6,9,12]; stale Convex ledgers reseed automatically.
Latency (measured: policy 1.6-2.6 s, TTS 0.25-0.48 s): think ahead 1.2 s after screen events, ask at once when a prepared question lands in a pause, prefetch held questions' audio.
open_items_for_session_2: ElevenLabs agents still carry their old prompts (amounts in 'dollars') until `node scripts/create-elevenlabs-agents.mjs` is run; not run in Session 1 because it changes the external agents.
Teach mode reads the screen from ProcureFlow's exact app state; it does not capture screenshots of the trainee's screen (that would need screen sharing in Teach).
Not tested with real human speech or a real shared desktop (headless Chrome: fake microphone, synthetic canvas screen). Speech-endpoint timing is covered by unit tests only.
The demo date 2026-10-04 is a Sunday; the brief's story moment is a Thursday afternoon.
Production Convex will reseed its invoices once on the first load after deploy (old 2025/USD ledger), which resets demo invoice progress once.
Redaction keeps only identifiers ProcureFlow registers; identifiers of other apps can still be misclassified by the PII model.
